assets.label: 轻点
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 短促且比 click4/5 低的频谱重心；适合高频点击后结束，降低增益避免抢词音。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 轻选
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 约 0.11 秒；频谱重心低于 rollover2/3/4，较 rollover6 明亮，可与受阻提示区分。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 翻开
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 使用书本打开拟音匹配纸艺界面；0.15 秒避免遮住引导。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 合上
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 与 bookOpen 同材质，0.23 秒；对解码后的样本峰值衰减后编码。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 翻页
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 三种 bookFlip 中最短，轻量纸页摩擦；保留原尾音，靠默认低音量使用。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 轻提醒
suggestedEvents: 资源不足、暂不可用、温和重试
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 频谱重心约 383 Hz、约 0.17 秒；避开蜂鸣器和长错误警报，仅作轻提示。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 结束录音
suggestedEvents: 录音完全停止后的提示，默认禁用
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 约 0.57 秒短拨弦；与录音分开触发，避免进入儿童录音。默认禁用由运行时配置决定。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 小成功
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 约 0.80 秒；客观主峰序列呈上升走势，短于 PIZZI02，适合普通成功层级。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 贝壳轻响
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 同系列较短硬币操作声，0.34 秒且原始样本峰值较低，用作贝壳物品声。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 小水滴
assets.author: rubberduck
assets.selectionReason: 三种 bubble 中最短且频谱重心最低，适合水滴数量轻提示。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 礼袋展开
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 0.66 秒柔性材质展开，频谱重心低于 clothBelt；用于包装动作而非警报。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 种子揭晓
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 0.46 秒短拨弦；客观主峰从较低到较高，突出揭晓瞬间而不持续播放。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 轻放种子
suggestedEvents: 播种、选中花盆后的落种
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 0.34 秒轻物品操作声，低于硬币操作的频谱重心；保留纸艺花园轻触质感。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 轻浇水
assets.author: rubberduck
assets.selectionReason: 0.72 秒；相对 splash06/08 较低的频谱重心，短于 splash01/07，适合单次水流反馈。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 开花
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 约 0.96 秒；主峰序列整体上升，比普通成功更长，用于稀少的成长完成。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 挑战开始
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 约 0.56 秒双音拨弦，主峰先低后高；避免长开场音乐遮住示范。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

assets.label: 挑战完成
assets.author: Kenney
assets.selectionReason: 约 0.81 秒多音拨弦；与成功和开花使用不同序列，保留完成层级区分。

processing.method: FFmpeg compatibility transcode; mono 44100 Hz MP3 96 kbps; linear gain only; no trimming or synthesis

validation.method: All candidates fetched using the actual local Soundbox catalog preview API, pinned source SHA-256 checked, float PCM decoded using FFmpeg; measurements and frequency analysis are objective screening only. No human listening was performed.
